definition.description: The most-cited works in OpenAlex's Artificial Intelligence subfield, with every author and every citation edge that falls inside the set.
definition.name: Artificial Intelligence

identity_bands.high: This record carries a person-claimed ORCID and no signal that it mixes two people.
identity_bands.low: This record may describe more than one person. It is shown as the source publishes it and has not been split or merged here.
identity_bands.medium: This record is probably one person, but at least one signal is weak. Check the evidence below before relying on the totals.

institution_mobility.supports: At most {value} distinct institution(s) inside any five-year window, which is a normal career.
institution_mobility.weakens: At most {value} distinct institution(s) inside any five-year window. That is more moves than a career usually contains and is the usual shape of a merge.

name_variants.supports: {n} distinct name form(s) across this row's works, counting a spelled-out given name and its initial as one form.
name_variants.weakens: {n} distinct name form(s) across this row's works. Several unrelated spellings is the usual shape of two people sharing one record.

orcid.neutral: No ORCID on this record, so its identity rests on inference alone.
orcid.supports: An ORCID is claimed by a person, not inferred, so it is the only identity assertion here that a human made.

topic_coherence.neutral: No field information on this row's works.
topic_coherence.supports: {pct} of this row's works sit in its single largest field.
topic_coherence.weakens: Only {pct} of this row's works sit in its single largest field, so this record spreads across subjects a single researcher rarely spans.

works_in_corpus.neutral: Confidence is judged on the {value} work(s) this corpus holds, not on the author's whole output. A single-work row carries little evidence either way.

quality_bands.complete: Nothing in this record contradicts itself and no field we check is missing.
quality_bands.partial: One field of this record is missing or disagrees with another. What is shown below is what the source publishes.
quality_bands.suspect: Several fields of this record are missing or contradict each other. Treat its figures with suspicion — it is shown unaltered because correcting a source's record silently is worse than showing you the problem.

authors.weakens: The source lists no authors for this work at all, so there is nobody to attribute it to and it appears on no author page.

doi_year.neutral: The DOI carries no year to check against.
doi_year.supports: The DOI's year agrees with the publication year.
doi_year.weakens: The DOI names {doi_year} but the record dates this to {value}. One of the two is about a different paper.

references.weakens: No references are recorded despite {value} citations. A paper this heavily cited did not cite nothing, so the record is incomplete.

title.weakens: The source record carries no title.
